class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/ImuSensor
class.description: Exports a MuJoCo gyro/accelerometer/framequat triple as IMU state interfaces, compatible with imu_sensor_broadcaster.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/ForceTorqueSensor
class.description: Exports a MuJoCo force/torque sensor pair as wrench state interfaces, compatible with force_torque_sensor_broadcaster.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/PoseSensor
class.description: Exports a MuJoCo framepos/framequat pair as pose state interfaces, compatible with pose_broadcaster.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/PidJointController
class.description: Claims a joint's position/velocity/acceleration command interfaces and drives them into qfrc_applied with a software PD/PID loop, for whichever of them has no matching MuJoCo actuator.
